method: Visual inspection of every native plate in contact sheets and all local seam strips; full-resolution guide comparison for suspected layout substitution.

limitations: Reviewed candidates, not user-approved final art.
Small roof/fence/field geometry and material differences remain; not a measured terrain reconstruction.
Outer transition to older context imagery remains visible at large zoom.
Veles registration is approximate; forest gate differs by about 140m.
Settlement outskirts and inter-settlement terrain are not complete.
No UE runtime or collision/walkability validation.
